name: Enavatuzumab
sponsor: Facet Biotech / PDL BioPharma -> Abbott -> AbbVie Biotherapeutics
agonist_antagonist: context-dependent: inhibits tumour cell growth and induces ADCC on its own; no IL8/cell-death agonism unless oligomerised or FcgR-bound, which converts it into a potent agonist
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
vh_vl_public: no (not in the papers read; patents not searched)
epitope_method: loss of binding to W42A and R56P point mutants, stated in the Trebing 2014 abstract as a contrast to the llama antibodies
competes_with_TWEAK: not established in the sources read
notes: Parent mouse mAb 19.2.1 (IgG2a). Phase 1 dose-limiting toxicities were grade 3-4 lipase, amylase and bilirubin elevations. Which of W42A/R56P affects enavatuzumab vs P4A8 individually is not resolved at abstract level.

name: P4A8
modality: anti-Fn14 antibody; scFv used in immunotoxins
sponsor: academic (Wuerzburg; Tehran Univ. Med. Sci. for the immunotoxin work)
agonist_antagonist: same pattern as enavatuzumab: not agonistic alone, strongly agonistic after oligomerisation or FcgR binding
internalization_evidence: implied by immunotoxin activity, not directly measured in the sources read
competes_with_TWEAK: not established in the sources read
notes: Used as the targeting scFv in PE38-P4A8 and STX2a-PE15-P4A8 immunotoxins.

name: BIIB036
agonist_antagonist: agonist: induces Fn14 signalling and apoptosis in vitro; needs full Fc effector function and higher binding valency for maximal in vivo effect
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
epitope_method: binds Fn14 specifically, not other TNFR family members; no residue-level mapping in the sources read
competes_with_TWEAK: not established in the sources read
notes: Increasing antigen-binding valency enhanced antitumour effect, pointing to receptor cross-linking as the mechanism.

name: ITEM-4
modality: mouse mAb (research reagent) and immunoconjugate targeting moiety
agonist_antagonist: not characterised as agonist/antagonist in the sources read
internalization_evidence: yes: ITEM4-rGel internalises specifically and rapidly (within 2 h) in Fn14-positive T-24 cells, not in Fn14-deficient fibroblasts (confocal)
epitope_method: high-affinity anti-Fn14 binder; no residue-level mapping in the sources read
competes_with_TWEAK: not established in the sources read
notes: The clearest internalisation evidence in this table, so the most relevant precedent for an ADC-style payload.

name: 18D1
agonist_antagonist: becomes a strong agonist on oligomerisation or FcgR binding
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
epitope_method: blocks TWEAK binding at 0.2-2 ug/ml; binds W42A and R56P mutants efficiently, so its epitope differs from FNB-001/002
notes: ADCC-enhanced and ADCC-defective variants both reduced liver metastasis in a human colon carcinoma xenograft; only the ADCC-enhanced variant suppressed lung metastasis in RENCA.

name: 4G5
agonist_antagonist: becomes a strong agonist on oligomerisation or FcgR binding
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
epitope_method: blocks TWEAK binding at 0.2-2 ug/ml; binds W42A and R56P efficiently

name: 5B6
agonist_antagonist: becomes a strong agonist on oligomerisation or FcgR binding
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
epitope_method: does NOT efficiently block TWEAK binding; binds W42A and R56P efficiently
notes: Useful contrast: binds Fn14 without blocking TWEAK, so its epitope is likely away from the TWEAK footprint.

name: ITEM4-rGel
agonist_antagonist: cytotoxic conjugate; agonism not characterised in the sources read
competes_with_TWEAK: not established in the sources read
notes: 8- to 80000-fold more potent than free gelonin across 22 tumour lines.

name: hSGZ / humanized bivalent anti-Fn14 immunotoxin
agonist_antagonist: not characterised in the sources read
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
competes_with_TWEAK: not established in the sources read
notes: Only the title/abstract were read; the exact antibody moiety and its relationship to ITEM-4 were not confirmed.

name: PE38-P4A8
internalization_evidence: not established in the sources read
